measures.name: Active Policy Count
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS(Dim_Policy),
    Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active"
)

measures.name: Premium In Force
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    SUM(Dim_Policy[AnnualPremium]),
    Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active"
)

measures.name: Claim Count
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(Fact_Claim)

measures.name: Total Benefit Paid
Denied Claim Count
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Claim Count],
    Fact_Claim[Status] = "Denied"
)

measures.name: Denial Rate %
measures.expression:
VAR TotalClaims = [Claim Count]
VAR DeniedClaims = [Denied Claim Count]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(DeniedClaims, TotalClaims)

measures.name: Open Claim Count
Average Claim Duration Days
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Claim[DurationDays])

measures.name: Claim Ageing Days
measures.description: Average days open for currently-open claims (Submitted / Under Review), measured to the report as-of date. Phase 5 fix: previously measured to TODAY(), which sits well after the synthetic data ends, inflating every age.
measures.expression:
VAR ReferenceDate = [Report As-Of Date]
RETURN
    AVERAGEX(
        FILTER(Fact_Claim, Fact_Claim[Status] IN {"Submitted", "Under Review"}),
        DATEDIFF(Fact_Claim[SubmittedDate], ReferenceDate, DAY)
    )

measures.name: Total Commission
measures.expression: SUM(Fact_Commission[CommissionAmount])

measures.name: Total Commission - Prior Period
measures.description: Commission over the equal-length window immediately before the selected period. Phase 5: was DATEADD -1 MONTH, which for a year selection compared against a window overlapping 11 of 12 months (and so also changes [Commission Growth vs Prior Period %], which builds on it).
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Total Commission], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Commission Growth vs Prior Period %
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentPeriodCommission = [Total Commission]
VAR PriorPeriodCommission = [Total Commission - Prior Period]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(CurrentPeriodCommission - PriorPeriodCommission, PriorPeriodCommission)

measures.name: Total Billed Premium
measures.expression: SUM(Fact_Premium[BilledAmount])

measures.name: Total Paid Premium
measures.expression: SUM(Fact_Premium[PaidAmount])

measures.name: Outstanding Balance
measures.expression:
VAR BilledTotal = [Total Billed Premium]
VAR PaidTotal = [Total Paid Premium]
RETURN
    BilledTotal - PaidTotal

measures.name: Collection Rate %
measures.expression:
VAR BilledTotal = [Total Billed Premium]
VAR PaidTotal = [Total Paid Premium]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(PaidTotal, BilledTotal)

measures.name: Quote Line Count
measures.description: Detail-grain (state-line) quote count and conversion - the "multi-quote" one-to-many child. A 3-state case contributes 3 rows here.
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(Fact_QuoteDetail)

measures.name: Lines Won
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Quote Line Count],
    Fact_QuoteDetail[LineWonFlag] = 1
)

measures.name: Line Conversion Rate %
measures.description: Line-grain conversion rate = state-lines won / state-lines quoted. Do not compare this directly to [Case Conversion Rate %] without noting the grain difference - a case can be "won" while some of its individual state lines were not (e.g. bound in 2 of 3 quoted states).
measures.expression:
VAR LinesQuoted = [Quote Line Count]
VAR LinesWonCount = [Lines Won]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(LinesWonCount, LinesQuoted)

measures.name: Total Quoted Premium
measures.expression: SUM(Fact_QuoteDetail[QuotedPremium])

measures.name: Won Quoted Premium
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Quoted Premium],
    Fact_QuoteDetail[LineWonFlag] = 1
)

measures.name: Quote Case Count
measures.description: Case-grain (header) quote count and conversion. This is the "multi-quote" case level: one row per submission regardless of how many states it spans.
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(Fact_QuoteHeader)

measures.name: Cases Won
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Quote Case Count],
    Fact_QuoteHeader[CaseWonFlag] = 1
)

measures.name: Case Conversion Rate %
measures.description: Case-level conversion rate = cases won / cases quoted. Distinct from the state-line conversion rate on Fact_QuoteDetail - a multi-state case with 3 states counts once here, but as 3 rows there. Keeping these on separate tables (rather than one shared measure with a grain toggle) avoids accidental double-counting at the case grain.
measures.expression:
VAR CasesQuoted = [Quote Case Count]
VAR CasesWon = [Cases Won]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(CasesWon, CasesQuoted)

measures.name: Multi-State Case Share %
measures.expression:
VAR TotalCases = [Quote Case Count]
VAR MultiStateCases =
    CALCULATE(
        [Quote Case Count],
        Fact_QuoteHeader[MultiState] = 1
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(MultiStateCases, TotalCases)

measures.name: Data as of
measures.description: Header text: data currency (report as-of date) plus the selected reporting period.
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf = [Report As-Of Date]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
RETURN
    "Data as of " & FORMAT(AsOf, "mmm d, yyyy")
        & "  ·  Period " & FORMAT(PeriodStart, "mmm d, yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(PeriodEnd, "mmm d, yyyy")

measures.name: Member Headcount
measures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Member[MemberKey])

measures.name: Report As-Of Date
measures.description: Last date of loaded data - the reference date for renewals, ageing and "days open". Used instead of TODAY(): the synthetic data ends 2025-12-31, so TODAY()-based ages were inflated by however long ago that was.
measures.expression: CALCULATE(MAX(Dim_Date[Date]), REMOVEFILTERS())

measures.name: Lapsed Policy Count
measures.expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[Status] = "Lapsed")

measures.name: Policy Status Summary
measures.expression:
VAR Lapsed = [Lapsed Policy Count] + 0
VAR Active = [Active Policy Count] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        Active + Lapsed = 0, "– No policies",
        Lapsed = 0, "✓ All " & Active & " policies active",
        Active = 0, "✕ No active policy - " & Lapsed & " lapsed",
        "⚠ " & Lapsed & " lapsed - review coverage"
    )

measures.name: Policy Status Summary Color
measures.expression:
VAR Lapsed = [Lapsed Policy Count] + 0
VAR Active = [Active Policy Count] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), Active + Lapsed = 0, "#56666B", Lapsed = 0, "#1E7B3C", Active = 0, "#B42318", "#8A5A00")

measures.name: Coverage Lines In Force
measures.description: Distinct statutory coverage lines (Statutory Disability, Paid Family Leave) with an active policy.
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Policy[PolicyType]), Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active")

measures.name: Coverage Lines Label
measures.expression: FORMAT([Coverage Lines In Force] + 0, "0") & " of 2 lines"

measures.name: Statutory Coverage Status
measures.description: Whether both statutory lines are in force. In some states employers must carry both DBL and PFL; shown as a prompt to check, not a compliance determination (the model has no per-state obligation data).
measures.expression:
VAR HasDisability = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active", Dim_Policy[PolicyType] = "Statutory Disability") > 0
VAR HasPFL = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active", Dim_Policy[PolicyType] = "Paid Family Leave") > 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        HasDisability && HasPFL, "✓ Disability and PFL both in force",
        HasDisability, "⚠ Paid Family Leave not in force",
        HasPFL, "⚠ Statutory Disability not in force",
        "✕ No statutory coverage in force"
    )

measures.name: Statutory Coverage Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Lines = [Coverage Lines In Force] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), Lines >= 2, "#1E7B3C", Lines = 1, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Next Renewal Date
measures.description: Next policy anniversary (renewal) after the report as-of date, across active policies in context. Assumes annual terms renewing on the effective-date anniversary.
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf = [Report As-Of Date]
RETURN
    MINX(
        FILTER(Dim_Policy, Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active"),
        VAR Effective = Dim_Policy[EffectiveDate]
        VAR ThisYearAnniversary = DATE(YEAR(AsOf), MONTH(Effective), DAY(Effective))
        RETURN
            IF(ThisYearAnniversary > AsOf, ThisYearAnniversary, DATE(YEAR(AsOf) + 1, MONTH(Effective), DAY(Effective)))
    )

measures.name: Days to Renewal
measures.expression:
VAR NextRenewal = [Next Renewal Date]
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(NextRenewal), INT(NextRenewal - [Report As-Of Date]))

measures.name: Renewal Status
measures.description: Renewal window: <= 60 days red (act now - census and rate review due), 61-90 amber (prepare), otherwise green.
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days to Renewal]
VAR NextRenewal = [Next Renewal Date]
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK(Days), "– No active policy",
        Days <= 60, "✕ Renews " & FORMAT(NextRenewal, "mmm d, yyyy") & " - act now",
        Days <= 90, "⚠ Renews " & FORMAT(NextRenewal, "mmm d, yyyy") & " - prepare",
        "✓ Renews " & FORMAT(NextRenewal, "mmm d, yyyy")
    )

measures.name: Renewal Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days to Renewal]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Days), "#56666B", Days <= 60, "#B42318", Days <= 90, "#8A5A00", "#1E7B3C")

measures.name: Policy Status Label
measures.expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Policy[Status]), "Active", "✓ Active", "Lapsed", "✕ Lapsed", BLANK())

measures.name: Policy Status Color
measures.expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Policy[Status]), "Active", "#1E7B3C", "Lapsed", "#B42318", "#56666B")

measures.name: Policy Count
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(Dim_Policy)

measures.name: Policy Status Fill
measures.expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Policy[Status]), "Active", "#2E7D46", "Lapsed", "#B42318", "#B5C3C5")

measures.name: Premium In Force Status
measures.expression:
VAR Active = [Active Policy Count] + 0
RETURN
    IF(Active > 0, "Annualised · " & Active & " active polic" & IF(Active = 1, "y", "ies")
        & "  ·  avg " & FORMAT(DIVIDE([Premium In Force], Active), "$#,0"), "– No active policy")

measures.name: Collection Rate Target %
measures.description: Target: 98% of billed premium collected (assumed). Amber down to 95%.

measures.name: Total Billed Premium - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Total Billed Premium], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Billed Premium Status
measures.description: Context only (billed premium rising is neither good nor bad for the employer) - so shown neutral, not RAG.
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentPeriodBilled = [Total Billed Premium]
VAR PriorPeriodBilled = [Total Billed Premium - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE(CurrentPeriodBilled - PriorPeriodBilled, PriorPeriodBilled)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(PriorPeriodBilled),
        "ⓘ No prior period in data",
        "ⓘ " & IF(Change >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ ") & FORMAT(Change, "+0.0%;-0.0%") & " vs prior period"
    )

measures.name: Collection Rate Status
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Collection Rate %]
VAR Target = [Collection Rate Target %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Rate),
        "– No billing in period",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Rate >= Target, "✓ Meets", Rate >= 0.95, "⚠ Below", "✕ Below")
            & " " & FORMAT(Target, "0%") & " target"
    )

measures.name: Collection Rate Status Color
measures.description: >= 98% green, 95-98% amber, < 95% red. Also used row-by-row in the policy billing table.
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Collection Rate %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Rate), "#56666B", Rate >= [Collection Rate Target %], "#1E7B3C", Rate >= 0.95, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Open Receivables
measures.description: Billed minus paid across ALL billing periods (receivables are an as-of balance, not a period flow), still respecting employer / policy filters and RLS.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Outstanding Balance], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date))

measures.name: Unpaid Invoice Count
measures.expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Premium), Fact_Premium[PaidFlag] = 0, REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date))

measures.name: Oldest Unpaid Days
measures.expression:
VAR OldestUnpaid = CALCULATE(MIN(Fact_Premium[BillingMonth]), Fact_Premium[PaidFlag] = 0, REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date))
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(OldestUnpaid), INT([Report As-Of Date] - OldestUnpaid))

measures.name: Receivables Status
measures.expression:
VAR Invoices = [Unpaid Invoice Count] + 0
VAR OldestDays = [Oldest Unpaid Days]
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        Invoices = 0, "✓ Nothing outstanding",
        OldestDays > 60, "✕ " & Invoices & " unpaid · oldest " & OldestDays & " days",
        "⚠ " & Invoices & " unpaid · oldest " & OldestDays & " days"
    )

measures.name: Receivables Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Invoices = [Unpaid Invoice Count] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), Invoices = 0, "#1E7B3C", [Oldest Unpaid Days] > 60, "#B42318", "#8A5A00")

measures.name: Receivables 0-30 Days
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf = [Report As-Of Date]
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        SUMX(
            FILTER(Fact_Premium, VAR Age = AsOf - Fact_Premium[BillingMonth] RETURN Age <= 30),
            Fact_Premium[BilledAmount] - Fact_Premium[PaidAmount]
        ),
        Fact_Premium[PaidFlag] = 0,
        REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date)
    )

measures.name: Receivables 31-60 Days
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf = [Report As-Of Date]
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        SUMX(
            FILTER(Fact_Premium, VAR Age = AsOf - Fact_Premium[BillingMonth] RETURN Age > 30 && Age <= 60),
            Fact_Premium[BilledAmount] - Fact_Premium[PaidAmount]
        ),
        Fact_Premium[PaidFlag] = 0,
        REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date)
    )

measures.name: Receivables 61-90 Days
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf = [Report As-Of Date]
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        SUMX(
            FILTER(Fact_Premium, VAR Age = AsOf - Fact_Premium[BillingMonth] RETURN Age > 60 && Age <= 90),
            Fact_Premium[BilledAmount] - Fact_Premium[PaidAmount]
        ),
        Fact_Premium[PaidFlag] = 0,
        REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date)
    )

measures.name: Receivables 90+ Days
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf = [Report As-Of Date]
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        SUMX(
            FILTER(Fact_Premium, VAR Age = AsOf - Fact_Premium[BillingMonth] RETURN Age > 90),
            Fact_Premium[BilledAmount] - Fact_Premium[PaidAmount]
        ),
        Fact_Premium[PaidFlag] = 0,
        REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date)
    )

measures.name: Days Outstanding
measures.description: Row-level: days since the billing month for an unpaid invoice (blank once paid).
measures.expression:
VAR BillingMonth = MAX(Fact_Premium[BillingMonth])
RETURN
    IF([Open Receivables] > 0, INT([Report As-Of Date] - BillingMonth))

measures.name: Ageing Bucket Label
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days Outstanding]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Days), BLANK(), Days <= 30, "● 0-30 days", Days <= 60, "⚠ 31-60 days", Days <= 90, "✕ 61-90 days", "✕ 90+ days")

measures.name: Ageing Bucket Color
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days Outstanding]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Days), "#56666B", Days <= 30, "#56666B", Days <= 60, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Paid Premium Status
measures.expression:
VAR UnpaidFromPeriod = [Outstanding Balance]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK([Total Billed Premium]),
        "– No billing in period",
        IF(UnpaidFromPeriod > 0, "ⓘ " & FORMAT(UnpaidFromPeriod, "$#,0") & " of this period's billing unpaid", "✓ Period billing paid in full")
    )

measures.name: Enrolled Members
measures.description: Members enrolled on or before the end of the period in context (so on a monthly axis it is the month-end headcount). Dim_Member has no date relationship; the period is applied to EnrollmentDate explicitly. [Member Headcount] ignores dates entirely, which is why the Phase 1 enrollment "trend" line was flat.
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
RETURN
    CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Member[MemberKey]), Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate] <= PeriodEnd)

measures.name: Enrolled at Period Start
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
RETURN
    CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Member[MemberKey]), Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate] < PeriodStart)

measures.name: New Enrollments
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Member[MemberKey]),
        Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate] >= PeriodStart,
        Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate] <= PeriodEnd
    )

measures.name: Enrollment Growth Status
measures.description: Context, not RAG: headcount growth is the employer's business, not a service level.
measures.expression:
VAR AtStart = [Enrolled at Period Start] + 0
VAR NewInPeriod = [New Enrollments] + 0
RETURN
    IF(
        AtStart = 0,
        "ⓘ " & NewInPeriod & " enrolled during the period",
        "ⓘ " & IF(NewInPeriod > 0, "▲ ", "") & FORMAT(DIVIDE(NewInPeriod, AtStart), "+0.0%") & " since period start (" & NewInPeriod & " new)"
    )

measures.name: New Enrollment Status
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
VAR PriorNew =
    CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Member[MemberKey]),
        Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate] >= PeriodStart - PeriodDays,
        Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate] < PeriodStart
    )
RETURN
    "ⓘ " & PriorNew + 0 & " in the prior equal-length period"

measures.name: Members with Claims
measures.description: Distinct members who submitted at least one claim in the period.
measures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT(Fact_Claim[MemberKey])

measures.name: Claim Incidence %
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Members with Claims], [Enrolled Members])

measures.name: Claim Incidence Status
measures.expression:
VAR Incidence = [Claim Incidence %]
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(Incidence), "– No enrolled members", "ⓘ " & FORMAT(Incidence, "0.0%") & " of enrolled members filed a claim")

measures.name: Average Tenure (Months)
measures.description: Average months enrolled at period end (members enrolled by then). Also the row value in the roster.
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
RETURN
    AVERAGEX(
        FILTER(Dim_Member, Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate] <= PeriodEnd),
        DATEDIFF(Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate], PeriodEnd, MONTH)
    )

measures.name: Tenure Status
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR UnderSixMonths =
    COUNTROWS(FILTER(Dim_Member, Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate] <= PeriodEnd && DATEDIFF(Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate], PeriodEnd, MONTH) < 6))
RETURN
    "ⓘ " & UnderSixMonths + 0 & " members under 6 months"

measures.name: Enrollment Label
measures.description: Row label for the roster; blank for members not yet enrolled at period end (so they drop out of the table).
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR Enrolled = MAX(Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate])
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Enrolled) || Enrolled > PeriodEnd, BLANK(), Enrolled >= PeriodStart, "★ New this period", "Enrolled")

measures.name: Decision Target Days
measures.description: Service standard: claims decided within 14 days of submission on average (assumed; every decided claim in the synthetic data is within 30 days, so a 30-day measure would show nothing).

measures.name: Days to Decision (Avg)
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX(
    FILTER(Fact_Claim, NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Claim[DecisionDate])),
    DATEDIFF(Fact_Claim[SubmittedDate], Fact_Claim[DecisionDate], DAY)
)

measures.name: Decision Time Status
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days to Decision (Avg)]
VAR Target = [Decision Target Days]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Days),
        "– No decisions in period",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Days <= Target, "✓ Within", Days <= Target * 1.25, "⚠ Over", "✕ Over")
            & " " & Target & "-day service standard"
    )

measures.name: Decision Time Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days to Decision (Avg)]
VAR Target = [Decision Target Days]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Days), "#56666B", Days <= Target, "#1E7B3C", Days <= Target * 1.25, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Decision Time Fill
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days to Decision (Avg)]
VAR Target = [Decision Target Days]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Days), "#B5C3C5", Days <= Target, "#2E7D46", Days <= Target * 1.25, "#C07F12", "#B42318")

measures.name: Claim Count - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Claim Count], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Claims Submitted Status
measures.description: Context only: claim volume reflects the workforce's leave needs, not performance.
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentPeriodClaims = [Claim Count] + 0
VAR PriorPeriodClaims = [Claim Count - Prior Period]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(PriorPeriodClaims),
        "ⓘ No prior period in data",
        "ⓘ " & IF(CurrentPeriodClaims >= PriorPeriodClaims, "▲ ", "▼ ")
            & FORMAT(DIVIDE(CurrentPeriodClaims - PriorPeriodClaims, PriorPeriodClaims), "+0%;-0%") & " vs prior period"
    )

measures.name: Open Claims Over 30 Days
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf = [Report As-Of Date]
RETURN
    COUNTROWS(FILTER(Fact_Claim, Fact_Claim[Status] IN {"Submitted", "Under Review"} && AsOf - Fact_Claim[SubmittedDate] > 30))

measures.name: Open Claims Status
measures.description: Open-claim backlog health: none over 30 days green, up to half amber, more than half red.
measures.expression:
VAR OpenClaims = [Open Claim Count] + 0
VAR Stale = [Open Claims Over 30 Days] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        OpenClaims = 0, "✓ No open claims",
        Stale = 0, "✓ All open under 30 days",
        DIVIDE(Stale, OpenClaims) <= 0.5, "⚠ " & Stale & " open over 30 days",
        "✕ " & Stale & " of " & OpenClaims & " open over 30 days"
    )

measures.name: Open Claims Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR OpenClaims = [Open Claim Count] + 0
VAR Stale = [Open Claims Over 30 Days] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), Stale = 0, "#1E7B3C", DIVIDE(Stale, OpenClaims) <= 0.5, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Denial Rate % - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Denial Rate %], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Denial Rate Status
measures.description: Context only: denial is an eligibility outcome, not something the employer manages to a target.
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Denial Rate %]
VAR Prior = [Denial Rate % - Prior Period]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Rate),
        "– No claims in period",
        "ⓘ " & [Denied Claim Count] + 0 & " denied"
            & IF(NOT ISBLANK(Prior), "  ·  " & FORMAT((Rate - Prior) * 100, "+0.0;-0.0") & " pts vs prior", "")
    )

measures.name: Days Open
measures.description: Row-level (open-claims table): days since submission for an open claim, to the report as-of date.
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf = [Report As-Of Date]
RETURN
    MAXX(FILTER(Fact_Claim, Fact_Claim[Status] IN {"Submitted", "Under Review"}), INT(AsOf - Fact_Claim[SubmittedDate]))

measures.name: Days Open Color
measures.description: <= 14 days neutral, 15-30 amber (chase), > 30 red (escalate).
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days Open]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Days), "#56666B", Days <= 14, "#56666B", Days <= 30, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Claim Status Label
measures.expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(Fact_Claim[Status]),
    "Submitted", "◔ Submitted",
    "Under Review", "◑ Under review",
    "Approved", "✓ Approved",
    "Paid", "✓ Paid",
    "Closed", "✓ Closed",
    "Denied", "✕ Denied",
    BLANK()
)

measures.name: Claim Status Color
measures.expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE(Fact_Claim[Status]), "Denied", "#B42318", "Submitted", "#8A5A00", "Under Review", "#8A5A00", "#1E7B3C")

measures.name: Claim Status Fill
measures.description: Pipeline colours: light-to-dark teal as a claim moves toward payment, red for denied (not a RAG scale).
measures.expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(Fact_Claim[Status]),
    "Submitted", "#8FC7C7",
    "Under Review", "#5FADAD",
    "Approved", "#2E8B8B",
    "Paid", "#0F5C5C",
    "Closed", "#56666B",
    "Denied", "#B42318",
    "#B5C3C5"
)

measures.name: Member Greeting
measures.description: Under MemberPortalRole RLS this is always the signed-in member; in Desktop without a role it says it is an all-member demo view.
measures.expression:
VAR MemberName = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Member[MemberName])
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(MemberName), "All members (demo view)", "Hello, " & MemberName)

measures.name: Member Context
measures.expression:
VAR MemberKey = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Member[MemberKey])
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(MemberKey),
        "Pick a member in the header to see their view",
        SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Employer[EmployerName]) & "  ·  " & SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Member[EmploymentClass])
            & "  ·  covered since " & FORMAT(SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Member[EnrollmentDate]), "mmm yyyy")
    )

measures.name: Member Coverage Summary
measures.description: Which statutory benefits the member's employer has in force (member -> employer -> policy via the bidirectional r-member-employer relationship, the same path MemberPortalRole RLS relies on).
measures.expression:
VAR HasDisability = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active", Dim_Policy[PolicyType] = "Statutory Disability") > 0
VAR HasPFL = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active", Dim_Policy[PolicyType] = "Paid Family Leave") > 0
RETURN
    IF(HasDisability, "Disability ✓", "Disability ✕") & "   " & IF(HasPFL, "Family leave ✓", "Family leave ✕")

measures.name: Member Coverage Status
measures.expression:
VAR Lines = [Coverage Lines In Force] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        Lines >= 2, "✓ You're covered for both benefits",
        Lines = 1, "⚠ One benefit in force - ask HR about the other",
        "✕ No active coverage - contact your HR team"
    )

measures.name: Coverage Description
measures.description: Plain-language description of each benefit for the Member portal (a member reads "what does this cover for me?", not a policy type code).
measures.expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Policy[PolicyType]),
    "Statutory Disability", "Pays part of your wages if an off-the-job illness or injury stops you working",
    "Paid Family Leave", "Paid time off to bond with a new child, care for a seriously ill family member, or for a military deployment",
    BLANK()
)

measures.name: Member Next Step
measures.description: Row-level "what happens next" in plain language for the member's claim list.
measures.expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(Fact_Claim[Status]),
    "Submitted", "We've received it and will start our review",
    "Under Review", "We're reviewing it - we may contact you for documents",
    "Approved", "Approved - your payment is being scheduled",
    "Paid", "Paid - nothing more to do",
    "Closed", "Complete - nothing more to do",
    "Denied", "Not approved - your decision letter explains how to appeal",
    BLANK()
)

measures.name: Approved Claim Count
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Claim Count], Fact_Claim[Status] IN {"Approved", "Paid", "Closed"})

measures.name: Last Claim Date
measures.expression: MAX(Fact_Claim[SubmittedDate])

measures.name: Claims Filed Status
measures.expression:
VAR LastFiled = [Last Claim Date]
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(LastFiled), "No claims filed yet", "ⓘ Most recent filed " & FORMAT(LastFiled, "mmm d, yyyy"))

measures.name: Member Open Claims Status
measures.expression:
VAR OpenClaims = [Open Claim Count] + 0
RETURN
    IF(OpenClaims = 0, "✓ Nothing waiting on a decision", "◑ " & OpenClaims & " in review - we aim to decide within 14 days")

measures.name: Member Open Claims Color
measures.expression: IF([Open Claim Count] + 0 = 0, "#1E7B3C", "#8A5A00")

measures.name: Payment Count
measures.description: Claims that have been paid (Paid or Closed) - one benefit payment per claim in this model.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Claim Count], Fact_Claim[Status] IN {"Paid", "Closed"})

measures.name: Benefits Received Status
measures.expression:
VAR Payments = [Payment Count] + 0
RETURN
    IF(Payments = 0, "No benefit payments yet", "ⓘ Across " & Payments & " paid claim" & IF(Payments = 1, "", "s"))

measures.name: Member Decision Status
measures.expression:
VAR Days = [Days to Decision (Avg)]
VAR Target = [Decision Target Days]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Days),
        "No decisions yet",
        IF(Days <= Target, "✓ ", "⚠ ") & "Decided in " & FORMAT(Days, "0") & " days on average - our standard is " & Target
    )

measures.name: Leave Days
measures.description: Total days of leave / disability across claims in context.
measures.expression: SUM(Fact_Claim[DurationDays])

measures.name: Benefit Paid by Payment Date
measures.description: Benefits paid, dated by payment (DecisionDate) instead of claim submission - via the inactive r-claim-decisiondate relationship. DecisionDate is used as the payment date: the model has no separate payment-date column.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Total Benefit Paid], USERELATIONSHIP(Fact_Claim[DecisionDate], Dim_Date[Date]))

measures.name: Cumulative Benefits Received
measures.description: Running total of benefits received up to the end of the period in context (by payment date).
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
RETURN
    CALCULATE(SUM(Fact_Claim[BenefitAmount]), REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), Fact_Claim[Status] IN {"Paid", "Closed"}, Fact_Claim[DecisionDate] <= PeriodEnd)

measures.name: Last Payment Date
measures.expression: CALCULATE(MAX(Fact_Claim[DecisionDate]), Fact_Claim[Status] IN {"Paid", "Closed"})

measures.name: Last Payment Status
measures.expression:
VAR LastPaid = [Last Payment Date]
VAR Amount = CALCULATE(SUM(Fact_Claim[BenefitAmount]), Fact_Claim[Status] IN {"Paid", "Closed"}, Fact_Claim[DecisionDate] = LastPaid)
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(LastPaid), "No payments yet", "✓ " & FORMAT(Amount, "$#,0.00") & " paid")

measures.name: Average Payment
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Total Benefit Paid], [Payment Count])

measures.name: Average Payment Status
measures.expression:
VAR Days = DIVIDE([Leave Days], [Claim Count])
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK([Average Payment]), "No payments yet", "ⓘ Claims last " & FORMAT(Days, "0") & " days on average")

measures.name: Employer Accounts
measures.description: Employer accounts with at least one active policy in the producer's book.
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Policy[EmployerKey]), Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active")

measures.name: Top Account Share %
measures.description: Share of premium in force held by the single largest employer account - book concentration risk.
measures.expression:
VAR BookPremium = [Premium In Force]
VAR LargestAccount = MAXX(VALUES(Dim_Policy[EmployerKey]), [Premium In Force])
RETURN
    DIVIDE(LargestAccount, BookPremium)

measures.name: Concentration Status
measures.description: Concentration: largest account <= 25% of premium green, <= 40% amber, above that red (one lost account would hurt).
measures.expression:
VAR Share = [Top Account Share %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Share),
        "– No active accounts",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Share <= 0.25, "✓ ", Share <= 0.40, "⚠ ", "✕ ")
            & "Largest account = " & FORMAT(Share, "0%") & " of book"
    )

measures.name: Concentration Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Share = [Top Account Share %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Share), "#56666B", Share <= 0.25, "#1E7B3C", Share <= 0.40, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Renewals Due in 90 Days
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(FILTER(Dim_Policy, Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active" && [Days to Renewal] <= 90))

measures.name: Premium Renewing in 90 Days
measures.expression: SUMX(FILTER(Dim_Policy, Dim_Policy[Status] = "Active" && [Days to Renewal] <= 90), Dim_Policy[AnnualPremium])

measures.name: Renewal Pipeline Status
measures.expression:
VAR Premium = [Premium Renewing in 90 Days]
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(Premium) || Premium = 0, "✓ No renewals in the next 90 days", "⚠ " & FORMAT(Premium, "$#,0") & " premium up for renewal")

measures.name: Renewal Pipeline Status Color
measures.expression: IF([Renewals Due in 90 Days] + 0 > 0, "#8A5A00", "#1E7B3C")

measures.name: Book Status
measures.expression:
VAR Accounts = [Employer Accounts] + 0
RETURN
    IF(Accounts = 0, "– No active accounts", "ⓘ Across " & Accounts & " employer account" & IF(Accounts = 1, "", "s"))

measures.name: Effective Commission Rate %
measures.description: Commission earned as a share of premium billed on the same policies and period (reconciliation check).
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Total Commission], [Total Billed Premium])

measures.name: Commission Growth Status
measures.expression:
VAR Growth = [Commission Growth vs Prior Period %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK([Total Commission - Prior Period]),
        "– No prior period in data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Growth >= 0, "✓ ▲ ", Growth >= -0.10, "⚠ ▼ ", "✕ ▼ ") & FORMAT(Growth, "+0.0%;-0.0%") & " vs prior period"
    )

measures.name: Commission Growth Status Color
measures.description: >= 0% growth green, down up to 10% amber, down more than 10% red. Also used row-by-row in the producer scorecard.
measures.expression:
VAR Growth = [Commission Growth vs Prior Period %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK([Total Commission - Prior Period]), "#56666B", Growth >= 0, "#1E7B3C", Growth >= -0.10, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Commission Rate Status
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Effective Commission Rate %]
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(Rate), "– No billing in period", "ⓘ of " & FORMAT([Total Billed Premium], "$#,0") & " premium billed")

measures.name: Policies Paid On
measures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT(Fact_Commission[PolicyKey])

measures.name: Policies Paid Status
measures.expression:
VAR Policies = [Policies Paid On] + 0
RETURN
    IF(Policies = 0, "– No commission in period", "ⓘ avg " & FORMAT(DIVIDE([Total Commission], Policies), "$#,0") & " per policy")

measures.name: Commission Months
measures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT(Fact_Commission[Period])

measures.name: Statement Period Status
measures.expression: "ⓘ " & [Commission Months] + 0 & " monthly statement" & IF([Commission Months] = 1, "", "s") & " in period"

measures.name: Conversion Target %
measures.description: Target case conversion (cases bound / cases quoted) of 35% (assumed; the synthetic book converts ~33%). Amber to 30%.

measures.name: Quote Case Count - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Quote Case Count], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Quote Volume Status
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentPeriodCases = [Quote Case Count] + 0
VAR PriorPeriodCases = [Quote Case Count - Prior Period]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(PriorPeriodCases),
        "ⓘ No prior period in data",
        IF(CurrentPeriodCases >= PriorPeriodCases, "✓ ▲ ", "⚠ ▼ ")
            & FORMAT(DIVIDE(CurrentPeriodCases - PriorPeriodCases, PriorPeriodCases), "+0%;-0%") & " vs prior period"
    )

measures.name: Quote Volume Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR PriorPeriodCases = [Quote Case Count - Prior Period]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(PriorPeriodCases), "#56666B", [Quote Case Count] + 0 >= PriorPeriodCases, "#1E7B3C", "#8A5A00")

measures.name: Case Conversion Status
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Case Conversion Rate %]
VAR Target = [Conversion Target %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Rate),
        "– No quotes in period",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Rate >= Target, "✓ Meets", Rate >= Target - 0.05, "⚠ Below", "✕ Below")
            & " " & FORMAT(Target, "0%") & " target  ·  " & [Cases Won] + 0 & " cases bound"
    )

measures.name: Case Conversion Status Color
measures.description: >= 35% green, 30-35% amber, < 30% red. Used for case-grain rates only.
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Case Conversion Rate %]
VAR Target = [Conversion Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Rate), "#56666B", Rate >= Target, "#1E7B3C", Rate >= Target - 0.05, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Case Conversion Fill
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Case Conversion Rate %]
VAR Target = [Conversion Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Rate), "#B5C3C5", Rate >= Target, "#2E7D46", Rate >= Target - 0.05, "#C07F12", "#B42318")

measures.name: Line Conversion Status
measures.description: Context, deliberately not RAG-scored against the case target: the two grains are not comparable; the gap between them is the insight.
measures.expression:
VAR LineRate = [Line Conversion Rate %]
VAR CaseRate = [Case Conversion Rate %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(LineRate),
        "– No quotes in period",
        "ⓘ " & FORMAT((LineRate - CaseRate) * 100, "+0.0;-0.0") & " pts vs case rate - per state line, not per case"
    )

measures.name: Line Conversion Fill
measures.description: State bars: dark = at or above your overall line conversion, light = below it (relative, not a target).
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Line Conversion Rate %]
VAR BookRate = CALCULATE([Line Conversion Rate %], REMOVEFILTERS(Fact_QuoteDetail[State]))
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Rate), "#B5C3C5", Rate >= BookRate, "#1B3A5C", "#8FA9BC")

measures.name: Won Premium Status
measures.expression:
VAR Quoted = [Total Quoted Premium]
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(Quoted), "– No quotes in period", "ⓘ " & FORMAT(DIVIDE([Won Quoted Premium], Quoted), "0%") & " of " & FORMAT(Quoted, "$#,0") & " quoted")

measures.name: Case Outcome Label
measures.expression: SWITCH(MAX(Fact_QuoteHeader[CaseWonFlag]), 1, "✓ Bound", 0, "✕ Not bound", BLANK())

measures.name: Case Outcome Color
measures.description: Lost cases in neutral grey, not red: losing a competitive quote is normal, not an exception to chase.
measures.expression: SWITCH(MAX(Fact_QuoteHeader[CaseWonFlag]), 1, "#1E7B3C", 0, "#56666B", "#56666B")

measures.name: Lines Won Label
measures.expression:
VAR Lines = [Quote Line Count]
RETURN
    IF(Lines > 0, [Lines Won] + 0 & " of " & Lines & " state" & IF(Lines = 1, "", "s"))

measures.name: Policy Retention %
measures.description: Active policies / all policies written - a simple persistency proxy (the model has no lapse dates, so not time-based).
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Active Policy Count], [Policy Count])

measures.name: Retention Target %
measures.description: Target policy retention of 85% (assumed). Amber to 75%.

measures.name: Retention Status
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Policy Retention %]
VAR Target = [Retention Target %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Rate),
        "– No policies",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Rate >= Target, "✓ Meets", Rate >= Target - 0.10, "⚠ Below", "✕ Below")
            & " " & FORMAT(Target, "0%") & "  ·  " & [Lapsed Policy Count] + 0 & " lapsed"
    )

measures.name: Retention Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Policy Retention %]
VAR Target = [Retention Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Rate), "#56666B", Rate >= Target, "#1E7B3C", Rate >= Target - 0.10, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

filters.expression:
VAR CurrentUserAccounts =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(Security_UserAccount[PortalAccountKey]),
        Security_UserAccount[UserPrincipalName] = USERNAME(),
        Security_UserAccount[RoleType] = "Employer"
    )
RETURN
    Dim_Employer[PortalAccountKey] IN CurrentUserAccounts

VAR CurrentUserAccounts =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(Security_UserAccount[PortalAccountKey]),
        Security_UserAccount[UserPrincipalName] = USERNAME(),
        Security_UserAccount[RoleType] = "Member"
    )
RETURN
    Dim_Member[MemberPortalAccountKey] IN CurrentUserAccounts

VAR CurrentUserAccounts =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(Security_UserAccount[PortalAccountKey]),
        Security_UserAccount[UserPrincipalName] = USERNAME(),
        Security_UserAccount[RoleType] = "Producer"
    )
RETURN
    Dim_Producer[ProducerPortalAccountKey] IN CurrentUserAccounts
